title: Miranda Lambert Speaks Up Against Concertgoers Distracted by Selfies [Watch]
htmlContent:
Country superstar Miranda Lambert isn't one to mince words, especially when it comes to her music and connecting with her audience. During her recent performance of "Tin Man" at her Las Vegas residency show, Miranda briefly paused to address fans who were more interested in taking selfies than listening to the song. In a TikTok video posted on July 16, Lambert expressed her frustration, stating, "These girls are worried about their selfie and not listening to the song. It's pissing me off a little bit."

While some concertgoers cheered in agreement with Miranda's sentiment, others didn't take kindly to being called out. In response to her interruption, seven people were seen exiting the venue, with one person audibly expressing their disappointment. On TikTok, reactions were divided, with some fans defending Miranda's stance, while others criticized her actions.

One TikTok user questioned, "Who doesn't take pictures at a concert?" implying that capturing memories is a common practice among concert attendees. Another commenter suggested that Miranda was out of line, explaining that the fans might have been taking selfies or videos to remember the occasion. The incident sparked a debate about the appropriate balance between enjoying the concert experience and capturing moments through technology.

While opinions varied, there were those who supported Miranda's decision to call attention to the issue. One fan commended her, stating, "Good for Miranda. This song is so special and beautiful." Lambert's dedication to her craft and desire for fans to fully immerse themselves in her music is evident.

Miranda Lambert's Las Vegas residency has been a unique experience for her, allowing her to stay in one place for an extended period, unlike her usual life on the road. She has expressed her appreciation for the chance to "just chill" and connect with her fans in a more intimate setting.

Despite the onstage interruption, Lambert's pre-show rituals continue to foster camaraderie and set the tone for her performances. She shared that before taking the stage, she and her band and crew always do a shot of good tequila together. Additionally, Miranda finds solace in the presence of her dogs backstage, emphasizing their role as good moral support.

Miranda Lambert's dedication to her craft and her desire for concertgoers to fully engage in the live experience is a testament to her passion as an artist. While opinions may differ on the appropriateness of her calling out fans taking selfies, her intent to create a meaningful connection through her music remains unwavering. As she continues her Las Vegas residency, fans can expect more heartfelt performances and a true reflection of Miranda Lambert's artistry.
